page.layout: One printed page, index in three columns. Running head "INDEX" centred at the top above the columns. Column 1 (left): entries "Deus" to "Deo nemo mortuus est", beginning with a continuation line. Column 2 (middle): entries "Deo qui sint mortui" to "Dilectio Christiana fratrum necessitatibus seruit". Column 3 (right): entries "Dilectio Christi qualis" to "Diuitiæ Dei,quibus in misericordia". Below column 3, a catchword-like mark "Q" at the left edge. No page number, no signature.

page.notes: Column 3 ends with "Diuitiæ Dei,quibus in mise-" followed by "ricordia", set at the right of the line; the mark "Q" lies below at the left and is not a catchword, so it is not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse and the left-edge fragments of the adjacent page are left out. Greek words "χαρις", "πονηρός" and "Διάθεσις" are uncertain at the letter level and are marked [?]. "bonem det 20.b" at the top is a fragment of an entry from the previous page. The printed spellings "recôciliator", "Deᵘ", "accedédus", "Disidia", "potest" and "Dilectiõe" are kept as printed.
